title: Finite etale restriction to a punctured power-series zero section is fully faithful
statement: Let A be a Noetherian local ring with maximal ideal m and depth at least two [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring, def-weil-pbc-depth]. Let d be a positive integer and B=A[[x_1,...,x_d]] [def-weil-pbc-multivariate-power-series]. Set Y=Spec B and let z:Spec A -> Y be the closed immersion given by the constant-coefficient quotient, identifying Spec A with Y_0=V(x_1,...,x_d) [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions]. Let V be any open of Y such that z^{-1}(V)=Spec A minus its closed point m. Put V_0=V times_Y Spec A. Restriction from finite etale schemes over V to finite etale schemes over V_0 is fully faithful: for every pair P,Q of finite etale V-schemes, the pullback map on V-morphisms P -> Q is bijective. No normality, integrality or connectedness is assumed.

source.place: Tag 0EY9 (Lemma 58.26.1), entire statement and proof; Tags 0BK0, 0EKP and 0EL8

proof.text: Identify the closed zero section Spec(B/I) with Spec A using constantCoeff, whose kernel is the variable ideal I. The hypothesis on V identifies its inverse image with the punctured spectrum U. Hartogs for the structure module at the closed point gives Gamma(U,O_U)=A. Each truncated power-series algebra is finite free over A on the monomials of degree below n, so its sections over U are A[x]/(x)^n. Passing to the inverse limit identifies the formal section ring with B.

Here is the injectivity detail omitted in 0EY9. A section with zero formal restriction has zero germ on V_0 by Krull intersection. Every associated prime q of B is pB with p associated in A: the flat local depth formula at q gives depth(A_p)=0 and depth of the fibre at q equal to zero; that fibre is a localization of the domain (A/p)[[x]], so its prime must be zero. Since depth A is positive, p is not maximal. Therefore pB+I lies in V_0 and specializes from q. The germ at q vanishes, and detection on associated points makes the section vanish on V. Thus Gamma(V,O_V) injects into its formal section ring B. The composition B -> Gamma(V,O_V) -> B is identity, making both arrows isomorphisms.

Expand the application of 0EKP. On the Noetherian quasi-affine scheme V the dual of any vector bundle E is generated by finitely many global sections. Dualize the resulting surjection to embed E into O^r with locally free cokernel Q. Embed Q into O^s the same way. The sequence 0 -> E -> O^r -> O^s is universally exact. Sections and inverse limits preserve its kernel. The isomorphism for O from the preceding step therefore gives the completion comparison for E. Applying it to the vector bundle internal Hom gives bijectivity on maps between completed vector bundles.

Expand 0EL8: a morphism between two finite etale covers of V_0 lifts uniquely to each infinitesimal thickening by formal etaleness. The resulting map between the completed finite locally free direct-image algebras lifts uniquely to a module map by the preceding completion comparison. Faithfulness applied to their tensor squares and to the unit bundle verifies multiplication and the unit. Relative Spec gives a unique morphism over V restricting to the original morphism on V_0. This is bijectivity of every hom-set map of the finite-etale pullback functor.

lean.statement:
theorem finiteEtale_powerSeries_punctured_section_fully_faithful
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [IsLocalRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A]
    (hdepth : (2 : ℕ∞) ≤ IsLocalRing.depth (R := A) A)
    (d : ℕ) (hd : 0 < d)
    (V : (Spec (.of (MvPowerSeries (Fin d) A))).Opens)
    (hV : ∀ x : Spec (.of A),
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (MvPowerSeries.constantCoeff (σ := Fin d)))) x ∈ V ↔
        x ≠ IsLocalRing.closedPoint A) :
    let z := Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (MvPowerSeries.constantCoeff (σ := Fin d)))
    ∀ P Q : V.toScheme.FiniteEtale,
      Function.Bijective ((FiniteEtale.pullback (z ∣_ V)).map (X := P) (Y := Q))
